body_html:
The Altona high back tilter brings a refined, leather-look presence to management offices and boardrooms without the executive-suite price tag. Wrapped in black Luxhide bonded leather over a contoured, waterfall-edge seat, it pairs a confident look with all-day comfort for long meetings and focused work sessions. A smooth tilter mechanism, tilt-tension control, and pneumatic height adjustment let every seat dial in to its user.

Features

  • Tilter mechanism with upright-position tilt-lock
  • Tilt-tension adjustment to match the user's weight and preference
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment
  • Contoured seat with a waterfall front edge to ease leg pressure
  • Durable nylon arms for everyday institutional use
  • Scuff-resistant arched base with dual-wheel carpet casters
  • Black Luxhide bonded leather upholstery

Specifications

Overall 24"W x 26.5"D x 41"H with a 16.5"–20.5" seat-height range, rated to 300 lbs. Tested to meet or exceed ANSI/BIFMA standards and compliant with GREENGUARD emissions guidelines. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 2-year warranty.

A practical, presentable ergonomic office chair for boardrooms, management offices, and clinic consult rooms.
